text: also when it comes to updating values like brush size, i dont want to have to even think about doing a select all to clear out the current value, i just wanto to click into it and immediately type a number and press enter and it updates for me properly

events.text: BrushScalar now arms replacement on every click, isolates the first inserted text regardless of cursor position, and commits/clamps the submitted value on Enter through a pure tested boundary.

resolution: Changed brush numeric fields to replacement-first editing: one click arms the visible value, the first typed character replaces the complete value even when a unit suffix or middle cursor position is present, and Enter parses and clamps the result. Pure boundary tests cover replacement, invalid input, negative values, and range limits.
